sources.snippet: To address these challenges, we introduce Sorbet, a transformer-based spiking language model that is more neuromorphic hardware-compatible. Sorbet incorporates a novel shifting-based softmax called PTsoftmax and a Bit Shifting PowerNorm (BSPN), both designed to replace the respective energy-intensive operations.

To our knowledge, Sorbet is the first model designed for language tasks that overcomes the challenge of deploying transformer-based language models on neuromorphic hardware, which does not support complex operations like division and square roots.
